title: Images of small balls around a point with non-surjective derivative are thin
statement: Let n, m ∈ ℕ, G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ (Euclidean spaces), x ∈ ℝⁿ and r, η, L ∈ ℝ with r ≥ 0. Assume: (i) G is differentiable at every z in the closed ball B̄(x,r); (ii) ‖DG(z) − DG(x)‖ ≤ η for every z ∈ B̄(x,r), where DG = fderiv ℝ G and the norm is the operator norm; (iii) ‖DG(x)‖ ≤ L; (iv) the linear map DG(x) : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ is not surjective. Then Lᵐ(G(B̄(x,r))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(2(ηr)·(2((L+η)r))^{m−1}), with truncated subtraction m − 1 and Lᵐ = volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn m) (x : Rn n) (r η L : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x r, DifferentiableAt ℝ G z) → (∀ z ∈ closedBall x r, ‖fderiv ℝ G z - fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ η) → ‖fderiv ℝ G x‖ ≤ L → ¬ Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G x) → volume (G '' closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (η * r) * (2 * ((L + η) * r)) ^ (m - 1))
